prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: OpenAI chat bot extrenal api query help
We have a complex chat bot using no code chatbot Landbot & integromat. This has Alot of limitations. I would like you to format the api in openai davinci in order to make a virtual sales assistant. I know how to do most of this but im stuck with external api calls etc we provide courier services. we need to integrate 1. validation of user inputted postcode or address using google maps api 2. distance between those addresses using google maps distance matrix we would then use the miles to work out pricing etc. Is this something you can help with if so when?
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need help connecting your Landbot/Integromat chatbot to external APIs so it can validate postcodes or addresses with Google Maps, calculate distance with the Distance Matrix API, and use that data for pricing in a virtual sales assistant.

I’m Noor, with 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, including work with LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, and NLP. I can help you structure the OpenAI prompt flow and the external API calls so the bot can reliably validate input, fetch distance data, and pass the result back into your pricing logic. I’m also comfortable with pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and PyTorch if any part of the workflow needs custom processing or decision logic.

If you want, I can help you map the exact request/response flow and identify where the integration is currently breaking. What part are you stuck on right now: the Google Maps validation step or the Distance Matrix call?
